broken.core: Core destroyed — it sheds its armor for the second half
broken.gunL: Left shoulder gun destroyed — less fire to the front and left
broken.gunR: Right shoulder gun destroyed — less fire to the front and right
broken.podL: Left missile pod destroyed — smaller volleys
broken.podR: Right missile pod destroyed — smaller volleys
broken.hipL: Left hip gun destroyed — less fire to the left and rear quarter
broken.hipR: Right hip gun destroyed — less fire to the right and rear quarter
broken.exhaustL: Left exhaust destroyed — it overheats sooner
broken.exhaustR: Right exhaust destroyed — it overheats sooner
broken.turrets: All turrets destroyed — the barrage has stopped
warn.sweep: Climb or dive away from the red ring's height
active.sweep: Sweeping — stay off the ring's height
opening.vent: Venting {t} — armor open. Shoot the core from the front
opening.purge: Shedding armor — it stops and holds fire
vent: Venting — the armor opens and the core is exposed
bodyHit: You hit its body — you can't fly through it
phase2: Second half — armor shed, it moves faster. The core stays exposed
briefing: It hovers low on patrol over the bay and turns its body toward its target. You can't fly through its body (you bounce off and take damage)

The front is heavy armor (shots barely hurt) with two shoulder guns. The guns lead you: don't fly straight, keep turning, read where the tracers come from and circle in from the thin sides or below the rear (blind spot)

Every turret you break (shoulder and hip guns, back missile pods) thins the barrage. When the hatch opens it fires a volley: decoy it with flares. When the guns glow red and a ring spreads, it's a spinning sweep: climb or dive off the ring's height
Firing builds heat; when full it vents: the armor opens and the core glows (shoot from the front — weak spot). Breaking the exhausts makes it vent sooner
Destroy the core or bring it below 40% HP for the second half: it sheds its armor and speeds up, but the front then hits the hull
